title: Six Flags to Announce 2026 First Quarter Results on May 7; Earnings Call Starts at 8 AM EDT
summary: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation (NYSE: FUN), the largest regional amusement park operator in North America, said today it will issue 2026 first-quarter results in the pre-market hours of Thursday May 7, 2026. Starting at 8 a.m. EDT that day, Six Flags management will host a conference call with the investment community to provide additional details regarding first quarter results and discuss the Company’s business outlook. Management participants on the call will include Six Flags CEO John Reilly and CFO Brian Witherow. Investors and all other interested parties can access a live, listen-only audio webcast of the call on the Six Flags investor website https://investors.sixflags.com under the tabs Investor Information / Events Presentations. Those unable to listen to the live webcast can visit our investor website shortly after the call’s conclusion to access a recorded version of the call.
